title: An event into a closed account reopens it with a notice (T watch decided); a spend on an account that later closed stays in its line (closed-account cells of the coverage grid)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Food 30,000 and Free to spend 50,000 (typed); an e-wallet holds 10,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Wed 6 Jan: 2,000 of food paid with the e-wallet. Fri 8 Jan the person closes the e-wallet: the closing moves its 8,000 to the bank (close:g). Tue 12 Jan a shop refunds 500 to the e-wallet: money into a closed account reopens it, with a notice. Fri 15 Jan a friend sends 1,000 to it. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the closing moves the e-wallet's money out
